title: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation in a Zig-Based Stratum-Compiler for Aether-Interpreter and Analysis of a Non-terminating Kernel Task
topic: A Chronos-Compiler compiler in Axiom-Interpreter, and the kernel that hung without an error
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We investigate a Zig-based Stratum-Compiler that translates arithmetic expressions into bytecode for the Aether-Interpreter. The compiler employs a balanced search tree to maintain operator precedence during parsing, and a lightweight kernel scheduler to execute compiled tasks. We formalize the strict height-balanced invariant of the parse tree, prove its preservation under insertion, and analyze the asymptotic complexity of compilation and interpretation. Theoretical bounds of $O(\log N)$ for search and insertion, and $O(N)$ auxiliary memory are verified through static AST inspection. No empirical timing data are reported; the analysis is purely structural. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/zig-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261106_170122_a_chronos-compiler_compiler_in}
